## Summary

Provide a short description of the change and the motivation.

## Type of change
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bugfix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Infra / CI

## Checklist
- [ ] I have run the project map generator (`npm run gen:map`) if I added/removed top-level files or routes
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I ran `npm run build` (backend) and `client/npm run build` (frontend) if applicable
- [ ] I added/updated relevant docs (PROJECT_SUMMARY.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / docs/project_map.md)
- [ ] I verified there are no secrets in the commits
- [ ] I updated DB migrations or provided a migration plan if schema changed
- [ ] I requested a security review if the change touches auth or secrets

## Deployment notes
Add any special instructions for deploy or migration.

## Related
Link related issues, PRs, or SKILL.md files.
